text:
alex: Heads-up — planning to land PR #24891 before the maintenance blackout tomorrow 03:00 UTC. CI is flakey, mac e2e failing intermittently.

maria: linking CI dashboard: https://ci.redwood.example/build/4242
maria: can we retest the mac-e2e only? it's a known flake

alex: @jon can you give a rebase slot? Need to rebase onto latest main to fix lint.

jon: I can carve a quick slot at 02:20 UTC if CI queue clears. Request a single rerun then.

alex: sounds good. If queue doesn't clear, plan B is canary-only rollout to dedicated for 4 hours and rollback job on failure.

liz: +1 on canary. Also suggest adding a fallback routing policy: prefer-region: us-west fallback-model: small

ci-bot: re-run queued: PR #24891 mac-e2e (started) — ETA ~12m

maria: pinging reviewers: @sam @taylor, need 1 approval for merge before freeze :eyes:

sam: giving eyes now. Left small comment about timeout, won't block.

taylor: approved :thumbsup:

alex: thanks — if CI is green we'll merge at 02:40 UTC. If still flaky, we'll delay and tag for next window. I'll update the PR with the canary plan.

jon: noted; I'll standby to open the canary and monitor metrics.

alex: done — updated PR with canary steps and rollback playbook. thread closed unless CI fails.
